recognize_zh: 一群成熟外觀的淋巴球，染色質粗塊狀，但比典型 CLL 細胞大，細胞質較多、淡藍色，邊緣不規則（箭頭），部分核呈卵圓或有輕微凹陷；這種形態多樣的淋巴球提示非典型慢性淋巴球性白血病（atypical CLL）。
features: Clustered lymphocytes that are larger and more heterogeneous than typical small CLL cells
Round to oval nuclei, some slightly indented, with coarsely clumped chromatin; no prominent nucleoli
Moderate to abundant pale-blue cytoplasm with irregular, sometimes ragged borders (arrows)
Occasional cells with lymphoplasmacytoid or cleaved appearance
No smudge cells in this field; RBCs normochromic
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows increased mature-appearing lymphocytes with morphologic heterogeneity. Many cells are larger than typical CLL cells, with round to oval or slightly indented nuclei, coarsely clumped chromatin, and moderate amounts of pale-blue cytoplasm with irregular borders (arrows). Prominent nucleoli are not seen, and red cells are unremarkable. Findings are suggestive of atypical chronic lymphocytic leukemia; flow cytometry (CD5, CD23, CD200, FMC7, light-chain intensity) and cyclin D1/t(11;14) testing are needed to exclude mantle cell and other B-cell lymphomas.

ddx.vs: Mantle cells often have notched nuclei and are CD5+ but CD23-/CD200- with cyclin D1 or SOX11 expression and t(11;14).
SMZL cells have polar villous cytoplasmic projections and are usually CD5- and CD23-.

ddx.dx: B-prolymphocytic leukemia or CLL with increased prolymphocytes
ddx.vs: Prolymphocytes have a single prominent central nucleolus and moderately condensed chromatin.
Reactive lymphocytes are polyclonal with a mixed T- and B-cell population and abundant cytoplasm that hugs adjacent RBCs.
